values.note: A Loop electric sites $30 a night, B Loop non-electric $20, tent-only sites $15. A $7 booking fee is added once per reservation, not per night; Campspot adds its own booking fee at checkout. Dump station $10 per use. County page, read 2026-11-11.

note: Itasca County Land Department park surrounding Bass Lake, 11 miles east of Effie, in 663 acres of red and white pine: electric sites in A Loop along the north shore, non-electric ones in B Loop along the east shore, and six tent-only sites on the southwest point. Swim beach at the southeast end, fishing pier at the picnic area, hiking trail around the south half of the lake. ATVs may only ride in and out of the campground. --Claude
summary: County page + campground map read: $30 electric (A) / $20 non-electric (B) / $15 tent, $7 booking fee per reservation, dump $10, 43 sites incl. 6 tent, vault privies, wells, dump; all sites reserved on Campspot except FCFS 15B-16B; 14-day limit; closing Nov 15, 2026 (stored season kept). Lakefront could not be earned: proposed lakeview.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (lakefront -> lakeview): the county map puts the odd-numbered A Loop sites (1A, 3A, 5A, 7A-9A, 11A, 13A, 15A) on the lake side of the road along the north shore and B Loop 1B-14B between the road and the east shore, and Campspot sells them as '30/50 Amp RV Waterfront' (8 sites) and 'Rustic RV - Waterfront' (14 sites). On imagery the A Loop lake-side pads end about 12-25 m from the water (e.g. pads at about 47.7930,-93.4031 and 47.7929,-93.4020, the one with a trailer ~24 m back), but every one sits behind a continuous fringe of shoreline trees, with only small docks and footpaths through it; the B Loop pads (around 47.7905,-93.3975) are likewise in woods behind the shore trees. Behind a thin line of trees is a view, so lakeview; no site shows open ground to the water. Campspot's site photos could not be read (CloudFront 403).

OHV side use: 'most of the trails are open to multiple uses that include hikers, bikers, equestrian use, and Off-Highway Vehicles of less than 1,000 pounds' and ATVs may ride in and out of the campground only. A general county campground with an OHV side; not an OHV staging camp.
Season: the county page says 'Bass Lake Campground in Effie will be closing on November 15, 2026'; the stored season (closes 11-14) already says so and was left alone. No opening date is posted.
Hookups electric 50 (Campspot amenities, 2026-10-13) left as stored: the county page names electric vs non-electric loops without amperage.

Website fine (https://www.itascacountymn.gov/282/Bass-Lake-County-Park-and-Campground). The second line https://www.campspot.com/park/bass-lake-county-park-and-campground is Campspot's marketplace page; the county's BOOK HERE link goes to https://www.campspot.com/book/bass-lake-effie-mn (now in booking.url).
